exclusion.policy: Read-only exclusion set; never clone, install, patch, or run these checkouts in this benchmark.

profiles.label: Intelligent Iterations content-gen
capabilities: Tool-guided topic discovery and claim synthesis.
Real carousel and script-plan generation with cross-platform packaging.
Manual result records separated by topic, hook, length, and format.
generation_principles: Choose one concrete claim before choosing the format.
Use a compact four-part beat sequence with one job per beat.
Treat topic, hook, length, and result as separate experiment fields.
Rotate tired hook angles instead of repeating one winning label.
limitations: License text is absent despite an MIT declaration in project text.
Outcome records are manual and there is no native source-video transcript step.
The isolated install reported unresolved dependency advisories.

profiles.label: AI Video Factory
capabilities: Trend intake and result normalization against channel size.
Transcript plus frame analysis into hooks, story beats, pacing, CTA, and on-screen text.
Multi-step script, storyboard, and visual QA flow.
generation_principles: Start from a result normalized to its local baseline.
Extract a reusable hook and story pattern before writing a new topic.
Keep hook type, story beats, pacing, and CTA explicit.
Judge the script and scene plan before expensive generation.
limitations: The custom license bars product or system use without written permission.
Silent fake-provider fallbacks conflict with workspace implementation rules.
The audience feedback loop and automatic hook tests remain roadmap items.

profiles.label: Head of Content
capabilities: Platform-specific outlier scores and recency weighting.
Hook, structure, pacing, retention, and CTA analysis.
Content-plan output built from observed outliers.
generation_principles: Find a local outlier before deciding which pattern matters.
Separate the hook, structure, pacing, retention device, and CTA.
Turn the pattern into a fresh formula tied to the new topic.
Keep discovery separate from script production.
limitations: There is no executable full-script generator or owned-result loop.
One analyzer path ignores its transcript input and needs wiring fixes.
Source acquisition was not invoked during the isolated audit.

profiles.label: viral-ops
capabilities: Channel-baseline virality ratios with short and long video separation.
Outlier collection, angle generation, swipe-file output, and blueprint synthesis.
A tested command-line package with deterministic scoring math.
generation_principles: Judge a result relative to the channel's normal result.
Explain the hook device and emotional trigger behind an outlier.
Generate several fresh adaptation angles before selecting one.
Synthesize repeated patterns into one production blueprint.
limitations: The native package analyzes metadata rather than transcripts or scenes.
It has no full script generator, owned-post analytics, or feedback loop.
Reported scan totals do not include a committed raw corpus.

profiles.label: Social Media Automation Suite
capabilities: Seven independent engines with queue, transform, publish, and analytics code.
Text, speech, audio, screenshot, and dynamic-visual transformations.
Distinct structures for motivation, fitness, travel, poetry, ASMR, and forum stories.
generation_principles: Choose a format family before deciding the script tone.
Keep ingestion, transformation, speech, publishing, and analytics separate.
Match the opening and pacing to the source format.
Design the script so one engine can produce it repeatedly.
limitations: A tracked configuration file appears to contain a live platform credential and account data.
The checkout was quarantined and no project code was run.
There is no general transcription step or owned-result learning loop.

profiles.label: Socheli
capabilities: Trend intake, scored concepts, hook, script, story plan, fact check, and QA council.
Speech, captions, music, B-roll, edit, packaging, and publish tools.
Instagram and TikTok analytics with style-pattern extraction.
generation_principles: Score the concept before writing the hook.
Lock the hook, script, and scene plan as distinct stages.
Run fact and quality checks before production.
Feed owned results back into a style-pattern record.
limitations: AGPL core requires isolation and license review before proprietary integration.
One speech environment is undocumented and not provisioned.
TikTok result collection has a publish-ID mapping gap.

profiles.label: Faceless YouTube Agents
capabilities: Top-video transcript pattern extraction described as hook, rhythm, structure, and retention loops.
Staged file checkpoints for script, images, speech, assembly, and private upload.
Real local FFmpeg assembly helpers.
generation_principles: Study several strong items before naming a repeated pattern.
Extract structure and rhythm rather than copying lines.
Apply the pattern to a new topic with original wording.
Save each production stage as a checked artifact.
limitations: No license is present, so code reuse is blocked.
An agent performs writing steps that the code itself does not implement.
Upload and file-path safeguards need fixes before any live use.

profiles.label: TikTok Viral Factory
capabilities: Declared supervisor, discovery, strategy, script, SEO, producer, publisher, and analytics roles.
A declared 30-second hook, problem, product, proof, and CTA sequence.
Working settings, schema, and model-helper foundations only.
generation_principles: Give each stage one clear responsibility.
Use a timed hook, problem, proof, and CTA sequence.
Write platform copy and script as separate outputs.
Reserve analytics as the input to the next strategy cycle.
limitations: Advertised agents, workflows, tools, and analytics modules are absent.
The repository has no license file despite a project-text claim.
This is a roadmap profile, not a native transcript generator.

profiles.label: AI Content Factory
capabilities: Cheap candidate generation followed by vision scoring and human approval.
Atomic concept claims with an approval queue before expensive rendering.
Working product, concept, approval, and render-state checks.
generation_principles: Explore many cheap claims before spending on final production.
Keep one central claim per candidate.
Judge candidates on explicit dimensions before human approval.
Render only the candidates that pass the tournament.
limitations: The shipped writing path relies on a small set of fixed UGC lines and fallbacks.
There is no transcription or audience-result loop.
Several external dependency versions are not pinned.

profiles.label: OpenMontage
capabilities: Proposal, script, scene plan, asset, edit, and compose stages with artifact gates.
Provider preflight, validation, timeline export, and publish abstractions.
Broad automated regression coverage and local export checks.
generation_principles: Give each stage an explicit input and output artifact.
Lock the proposal before the script and the script before the scene plan.
Run provider preflight and self-review at quality gates.
Keep production mechanics separate from audience intelligence.
limitations: AGPL terms require isolation and license review for proprietary integration.
Interactive launch paths were not run under the singleton policy.
Some setup dependencies and output-containment rules need tightening.

profiles.label: MoneyPrinterTurbo
capabilities: Topic, script, stock footage, voice, subtitles, music, and video rendering.
API and UI entry points with optional cross-post support.
Locked dependency install and extensive regression coverage.
generation_principles: Turn one topic into a complete narration before collecting assets.
Keep script, footage, voice, subtitles, and render as replaceable stages.
Validate paths and task state at API boundaries.
Treat volume rendering as production, not proof of audience fit.
limitations: The lock includes multiple packages with recorded security advisories.
Direct-run defaults need stronger auth and cross-origin limits.
Automatic posting and bundled audio rights require explicit safeguards.

profiles.label: ACTP owned control
capabilities: Rights-bounded reference context with copy and originality audit receipts.
Deterministic owner-calibrated spoken, specificity, tension, plain-language, and repetition checks.
Immutable script experiments linked to later owned-result telemetry.
generation_principles: Use structural patterns without copying language, identity, likeness, voice, or source assets.
Lock the central claim and evidence before writing the hook.
Run bounded audit-and-repair cycles before accepting a script.
Register accepted scripts so later owned results can update the method.
limitations: This run uses the same model and briefs as every external profile.
Prepublication quality checks are not audience-outcome predictions.
The control has an integration advantage because the audit and experiment services are owned.
